name: dth-hrh
title: Digital Transformation Handbook: Planning for Human Resources for Health and Health Worker Registries

directories.description: The working document of the DTH on health workforce registries: its document, chapters and blocks, including the L1 structured assets (generic personas, user scenarios, requirements, data elements).

Source material, frozen: the TWG manuscript outline (2026-10-02; sectioned by its own headings with cat-harness-tools/scripts/text-structure.ts, so the library page can show it) and the TWG glossary workbook (2026-09-29), as received. Never edited to answer a comment.

The working-group review record: internal authoring and Technical Working Group comments, one public-comment/1.0.0 file per comment (comments/PC-NNNN.json), one changeset/1.0.0 per change set (changesets/CS-NNN.json), one manifest per intake batch (batches/), and config.json naming the editors and committee. Same machinery as the smart-ra public review, at working-group scale; a public review, when there is one, gets its own store at review/public-comment/.

The handbook's glossary as folio-glossary/v1 SKOS schemes: the consolidated dth-hrh scheme, the TWG candidate definitions and the professional-council examples, built from the TWG workbook by tools/glossary/build_glossary.py.
Inbox for material not yet ingested.
This instance's work plan — one Markdown file per bean, managed with the `beans` CLI (`.beans.yml`).
People's outstanding items and the feedback raised against blocks; its inner directories are declared by `todos/todos.json`.

The trashcan that is kept: deprecated and removed content, each node declaring itself `folio-fsh-guts/v1` with where it came from. Where a cutover deposits the directory it removes from main. Never rendered.
